prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray (airbrush/mist) tan or a UV (tanning bed) salon — and what part of Charlotte are you in (zip or neighborhood)? That will let me recommend the best nearby options.

While you decide, quick tips to pick a great salon:
- Choose spray tanning for safest, most even results; UV tanning increases skin cancer risk.  
- Look for certified spray technicians (IGL, St. Tropez, VersaPro, Mystic certifications).  
- Check recent Google/Yelp reviews and before/after photos.  
- Ask about technician training, solution brands, shade customization, and patch-test policy.  
- Inspect cleanliness, booth/bedding condition, and bulb replacement frequency for bed salons.  
- Compare pricing and packages; many places offer first-time discounts or membership plans.

If you tell me spray vs. bed and where you are in Charlotte, I’ll give 3–5 top salon suggestions and tips on what to ask when you call or book.
